mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with declining housing starts (HOUST) indicates a manufacturing-led expansion stalling in the housing sector, signaling an imminent economic slowdown that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of INDPRO rising and HOUST falling does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, elevated Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.35) signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.35.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it indicates an overheating labor market that fuels inflationary pressures, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.35) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition FEDFUNDS > 0.35 and CPIAUCSL > 240 does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, declining housing starts (HOUST) relative to prior peaks signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines from its peak.
